reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified the normal Beko anti-crease phase as soon as the customer described drum turns after 'End' that stop when the door opens, explained it clearly, gave the right remedy (unload / disable per manual or model number), and sensibly listed the only signs that would indicate a real fault (heating, running when off, far beyond 2 hours) — matching the hidden truth with no part or engineer recommendation. Its first turn was somewhat generic and US-leaning (gas dryers, vent flaps), but it still asked for brand/model and resolved everything on the second turn. Conversation 2 never diagnosed anything: it ignored the customer's clear, repeated description that the dryer dries fine and only turns after End, pushed an irrelevant overheating/blocked-filter narrative, asked the customer twice to unplug and clean the filter then the condenser, and never answered the direct question 'is that really why?', leaving the homeowner no closer to understanding a non-fault.
